book.name: Hebreos
book.title: Yech kwaan mkee lo re xaa Israel

content: Kwaanzee nal nawdizhtra be tant re kwaan mseedla be yilo, re kwaan non doo lo xtizh Jesucrist. Nal nzhaal gak be mod xaa gro. Nu nawdizhtra be re kwaane:

content.text: xomod nzhaal laa be re kwaan nle zee nya be lo yalgut,
nu xomod nzhaal bare be lo Dios,
nu xomod nzhaal zhiib be yaa be yek wech be,
nu xomod roban re xaa ngut,
nu xomod naab Dios kwent mbizh gwluzhtlaka.

content: Nal nzhaal xen be lo re xcheen Jesucrist, nel sbaa nzhekla Dios.
Nel chelee tub xaa mka xni yek tub welt, nu mkayaa xaa kwaan nzelazh Dios lo xaa, nu mkayaa xaa Mbi Naban cheen Dios,
nu ngune xaa xomod chul nak xtizh Dios, nu xomod yo yalnabeyy cheen Dios lo yizhyo kwaan yo gwluzh,
nu chelee xaa nzhekla xaa laa xaa xnaz Dios, nyentra mod bare xaa lo Dios, nel naka mod zee kee xaa Xgann Dios lo krus stub welt, nu ngoo xaa xkyalnto Xgann Dios lo re myet.
Kwaane nak mod yizhyo leezha nla yey; nu cheleeya nzaaya zyen doo yalgon lo xaa nak cheena, mkayaa xaa kwaan chul kwaan nzaa Dios;
per cheleeya nebse yich nu yixnizh nzaaya, zee xobde Dios yizhyo ba, nel nik tik nanonta, zee telisa yeka.
Kwaan nkambaz be kayaa be lo Dios
Nkedoola nu gu, nixa snee nii nu, ne wen nu lee re gu nzhola naz kwaan nzhin lo yalnaban kwaan tira.
Dios nak tub xaa nali, nu nanyenlazht xaa re kwaan wen kwaan mle gu, nu xomod kakela gu xaa, gorna nle gu yudar re xaa Jesús, xaa nambey nak, nu xomod seetaka kale guya nal.
Nu sbaaka nzhekla nu le kad tub gu, zee wlipa ne gu lee gu kayaa kwaan nkambaz gu mbizh gwluzh.
Sbaa nagakt gu mod tub xaa nchaab; nzhekla nu le gu kwentaxa nle re nu, xaa wlipa ngwii lo Dios, zee nyela be kwaz be kwaan kayaa be, kwaan né Dios zaa Dios.
Gorna lee Dios nzhé lo Abraham: “Lee na le gak zyen doo re dii cheen lu”, kwaan leeka le xaa mcheroo xaa, nel nyentra stub xaa mas non lo xaa,
nu nzhé xaa lo xaa: “Wli na, le na zyen doo kwaan chul lo lu, nu le na gak zyen doo re dii cheen lu”. [Gn. 22:16-17]
Nu zee Abraham myela mlaz kwaan nzhé Dios zaa Dios lo xaa, nu Dios mzaaya lo xaa.
Nu gorna lee tub xaa mbezh le tub kwaan, ncheroo xaa kwaan le tub xaa mas non lo xaa; nu snee nkin le xaa kwaan nzhé xaa.
Nu sbaaka mcheroo Dios gorna nzhekla xaa luu xaa lee xaa telisa zaa re kwaan né xaa lo re xaa mleey xaa kayaaya.

Nu rop kwaane: kwaan né Dios nu kwaan mcheroo Dios, nlu telisa leeya gak, nel Dios nankadet. Zee mrexonn be mbii gax be lo Dios zee kanap Dios be zee kayaa be kwaan nkambaz be zaa Dios lo be, nu kwaane nle chul doo lextoo be.

Nu kwaan nkambaz be nle zee nye nzo be lo Dios zee nik tub kwaan nagakt be; leeya nak mod tub yiib kwaan nsekwaz tub bark leen nistoo zee zheta nzob bark. Nu kwaane nle zee nzho mod zhin be axta stub ta ler kwaan nsaaw leen yidoo cheen Dios, zee zhin be lo Dios.
Naz baa mzeeb Jesús, zee mxal xaa xnaz be, nu snee tira ngok xaa ngwleyy non doo cheen be, mod ngok Melquisedec tub ngwleyy non doo.
